final_message: No — none of these tools (repo, tests, git, episodes) can publish a checklist to a remote release system. Orienting each handle against that capability returned "unavailable in the reachable world" for tests, git, and episodes, and the repo handle only exposes local status/inspection actions (branch/clean state), with no publishing or remote-release capability present.
